title: Quantitative Real-Time PCR (qRT-PCR) Protocol
author: Ning Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ixecfje
materials: Analyze the real-time PCR result with the SDS 7000 software. Check to see if there is any bimodal dissociation curve or abnormal amplification plot.

steps.title: Prepare Gene Specific Primers
steps.instruction: Retrieve gene specific primers using Primer Premier 6.0 and Beacon designer 7.8 Software and order them from Bioneer (TaKaRa, Japan).

steps.title: Verify PCR Specificity
steps.instruction: After PCR is finished, remove the tubes from the machine and examine PCR specificity using a 3% agarose gel with 5 ml from each reaction.

steps.title: Perform Dissociation Curve Analysis
steps.instruction: Return the tubes to the SDS 7000 and perform dissociation curve analysis using the saved copy of the setup file.
